subject: english
question:
Read the following sentence and select its future tense form from the following options.

The food company promoted newly launched products at affordable prices.

options.text: The food company will be promoting newly launched products at affordable prices.
The food company promotes newly launched products at affordable prices.
The food company had promoted newly launched products at affordable prices.
The food company is promoting newly launched products at affordable prices.

solution:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. The food company will be promoting newly launched products at affordable prices. .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is an example of the** present simple tense**, which describes a habitual action.
 
• To convert a present simple sentence to the future continuous tense, we use the structure **"will be + present participle (verb-ing)"**.
 
• The future continuous tense describes actions that will be happening at a specific time in the future.

Correct sentence: *The food company will be promoting newly launched products at affordable prices.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Future Simple Tense:**

 
 
• **Structure:** will + base verb.
 
• **Example:** The food company will promote newly launched products at affordable prices.
 
• **Usage: **Describes actions that will occur in the future.
 
 
 
• **Present Continuous Tense:**
 
 
• **Structure: **is/am/are + present participle (verb-ing).
 
• **Example: **The food company is promoting newly launched products at affordable prices.
 
• **Usage: **Describes actions that are currently happening.
